manual.detail: CI-speed controls capacity variables. Leave CI_MERGE_CI1 unset/off for automatic whole-group overflow, optionally use an existing verified Namespace merge profile, and apply build concurrency3 after checking live runner waits. Daily Namespace usage summary/artifact at06:05UTC records previous-day execution minutes, not invoice dollars. Live grouping strategy is preserved.

recovery.detail: Revert routing or use the existing forced-local switch and lower build count; no stored data or service rollback.
